caption: The drawing depicts a pair of brass andirons positioned at the corner of a black or dark brown fireplace grate. The primary andiron in the foreground is rendered in full color, showing a tall, polished, golden-brass structure with a large spherical finial at the top, tapering down to a bulbous midsection, and further narrowing to a rectangular base with a circular decorative element on the side. This base is supported by three curved legs ending in rounded feet. A smaller, secondary andiron is shown in partial perspective, matching the size and design of the main one, but placed behind the colored fireplace grate. To the left of the colored illustration is a line drawing of the andiron, showing its measurements in inches on a small scale. The drawing is set on a light beige background with a thin rectangular border, and the artist's name, "J. Strloff," appears in the lower right corner.
title: Andiron (one of pair)
